about.title: The Story
about.storyP1: Hello world. I'm Sergey. My English isn't perfect, but this story is real.
about.storyP2: For ten years I built a music bar. Then I closed that chapter and came home.
about.storyP3: Last spring I fell in love with Bangkok's warmth, openness, and cannabis culture. I built an app and walked around showing it to people.
about.storyP4a: I did not launch it well. But the idea kept calling me back, and that is how
about.meetIntroA: WIZL is the Weasel Wizard of Weed Wisdom.
about.meetIntroB: He travels with his cat, meets curious creatures, and records every lesson in a magic Book.
about.strainsCountB: . The real magic begins when you add your own field notes.
about.youCan: Read a label, explore a name, and remember what you actually noticed. Your journal stays on your device.
about.cta: This time, WIZL is going into the world.
about.missionP1: Cannabis information is noisy, labels are inconsistent, and the same name can mean different things across producers and batches.
about.missionP2b: kind field guide and memory companion
about.missionP2c: for adults who want to be more curious, conscious, and honest about their experience.
about.journey1Desc: Where the first version and the first stories took shape.
about.journey2Desc: Shipping WIZL, listening to real users, and telling the story honestly.
about.journey3Desc: A compliance-first return for stories, research, and licensed partnerships.
about.valueLoveDesc: For the plant and the people
about.supportDesc: WIZL stays free while the supporter club is designed and compliance-reviewed. No payment is being collected now.
about.followSoon: The official channels will be linked when they are live.
